skill_name: Write a paragraph describing the technique used to design a bridge.
workflow: Designing a bridge requires careful consideration of many factors such as bridge type, loading condition, construction materials, structural system and wind/seismic requirements. When designing a bridge, engineers need to take into account the stresses that the structure will need to withstand, such as compression, tension and shear.
